how_to_apply: Locate Advertisement No. HO/HRM/RECR/2026-27/COM-01 and click "Click Here To Apply Online."

Complete the Registration process by clicking "Click Here For New Registration" and entering basic information; note the system-generated provisional registration number and password (also sent via SMS).
Click "Login" and enter the login credentials.
Complete the application process by selecting the position for which you are applying (only one position per candidate).
Pay the applicable Application Fee / Intimation Charges online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI).
Upload the required documents - photograph, signature, and other documents - as per the specifications in the notification's Annexure-I.
Use "Save and Next" to verify details before Final Submit, as no changes are permitted after final submission. Take a printout of the system-generated application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates can apply online only, from 29.08.2026 to 18.09.2026; no other mode of application will be accepted. No change of category is permitted at any stage after registration; the result will be processed based on the category indicated in the online application. No change/modification is allowed in particulars (name, category, date of birth, address, mobile number, email ID) after submission of the online application form. Not more than one application should be submitted; in case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited. Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks/NBFCs/Financial Institutions, including credit card dues, and have not regularized/repaid outstanding dues by the date of the appointment letter, shall not be eligible for appointment. Requests for change of contact number/address/email ID/examination or interview centre will not be entertained. All documents - educational qualification, caste certificates (including OBC Non-Creamy Layer), EWS certificate, disability certificate, experience certificate - will be verified with the issuing authority; wrongful submission may lead to debarment and legal action. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. In case of any dispute regarding interpretation of a version other than English, the English version will prevail. The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: UCO Bank Vacancy 2026 covers 20 posts under the Specialist Cadre, both in MMGS-II (Middle Management Grade Scale-II). Vacancies are provisional and may vary as per the Bank's actual requirements; the Bank reserves the right to interchange the number of reserved vacancies across categories as per Government guidelines. Candidates can apply for only one position - a candidate applying against one position's vacancy will not be eligible to apply against the vacancy of the other position. No vacancies under the Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) category - Visually Impaired (VI), Hearing Impaired (HI), Orthopedically Challenged (OC), or Intellectual Disability & Others (ID) - have been notified for either post in this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate from the Government of India for the latter categories). Educational qualification and experience are assessed as on 01.08.2026. All educational qualifications must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by the Government of India, with the final result declared on or before 01.08.2026. Candidates must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering; where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted to a percentage as per the University's norms.

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology/AI & ML/Data Science with minimum 50% marks, or MCA, or M.Tech/M.E. in Computer Science/Information Technology/AI & ML/Data Science with minimum 50% marks, from a Government-recognized University/Institution/Board. Certification in AI, Gen AI, NLP, or ML is preferred.
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification experience in development and implementation of AI, Gen AI, NLP, or Content Analysis-based projects.

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: Full-time B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science/Computer Science & Engineering/Software Engineering/Information Technology/Electronics/Electronics & Communications Engineering (or equivalent) with minimum 50% marks, or MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc in the above disciplines with minimum 50% marks, from a Government-recognized University/Institution/Board. An advanced degree in Cyber Security or IT is preferred. Candidates must also mandatorily hold one or more valid certifications from a prescribed list, including OSCP, OSCE³, OSWE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, CAISP, Offensive AI (SANS), or GenAI and LLM Security (SANS).
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification hands-on experience in offensive cyber security, covering areas such as Red Team operations, AI Red Team operations on Generative AI/Frontier AI models, penetration testing, or advanced vulnerability assessment.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for both Manager-AI/ML Engineer and Manager-Cyber Security is 25–35 years as on 01.08.2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories is as follows: Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with only one of the remaining categories. The maximum age limit specified applies to General Category and EWS category candidates as well.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fees/intimation charges are payable only through Online mode (Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI) from 29.08.2026 to 18.09.2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment must be borne by the candidate. Fees, once paid, will not be refunded on any account, nor held in reserve for any other exam or selection.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through an Online Written Examination and/or Screening and/or Group Discussion and/or Interview, or any other process decided by the Bank. A screening committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria; the Bank may decide the parameters for screening. Shortlisting is purely provisional, without document verification; candidature is subject to verification of details/documents as and when called by the Bank. Only the most suitable candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be called for the selection process - mere satisfaction of eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called forward. Qualifying marks for the written examination/interview/selection process will be decided by the Bank. The merit list will be prepared in descending order based on scores in the Online Written Examination and/or Group Discussion and/or Interview. In case of a tie at the cut-off score, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order (older candidates ranked higher). Details of the written examination structure, if applicable, will be intimated through the Bank's website.

content_sections.heading: UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Probation and Service Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must execute a service bond to serve the Bank for a minimum of 2 years, or pay ₹2 Lakhs if they leave the Bank before completing 2 years. Confirmation follows satisfactory performance and conduct during probation.

faq.question: Q1. What is UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is UCO Bank's notification (Advt. No. HO/HRM/RECR/2026-27/COM-01) for 20 Specialist Cadre posts - Manager-AI/ML Engineer and Manager-Cyber Security - both in MMGS-II.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 20 vacancies in total - 10 for Manager-AI/ML Engineer and 10 for Manager-Cyber Security.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UCO Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration and fee payment close on 18.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech, MCA, or M.Tech/M.E. in relevant Computer Science/IT/AI & ML disciplines (minimum 50% marks) for AI/ML Engineer; a similar engineering/IT degree plus a mandatory offensive-security certification (such as OSCP, OSWE, or GIAC GPEN) for Cyber Security.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 25 to 35 years as on 01.08.2026, with age relaxation for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 years), Ex-servicemen (5 years), and 1984 riot-affected persons (5 years).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹175/- for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and ₹850/- for all other candidates, inclusive of GST.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit uco.bank.in, go to Career > Recruitment Opportunities, register, log in, select the position, fill the application, upload documents, and pay the fee - all online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An Online Written Examination and/or Screening and/or Group Discussion and/or Interview, or any other process decided by the Bank, with a merit list prepared in descending order of scores.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UCO Bank Specialist Officer posts?
faq.answer: MMGS-II carries a basic pay scale of ₹64,820–93,960, plus DA, HRA/lease accommodation, CCA, medical benefits, and other allowances as per Bank rules.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for both Manager-AI/ML Engineer and Manager-Cyber Security posts?
faq.answer: No, candidates can apply for only one of the two positions; applying for one makes a candidate ineligible to apply for the other.
